PART I—Orders and Notifications by the Governor of West Bengal, the High Court, Government Treasury, etc.
WEST BENGAL STATE ELECTION COMMISSION
18, Sarojini Naidu Sarani (Rawdon Street)
Kolkata - 700 017
No. 3077-SEC/1D-242/2022 Dated, Kolkata, the 25th Day of November, 2022
ORDER
In exercise of the power conferred by Section 140 of the West Bengal Panchayat Act, 1973 read with Sections 16
& 17 of the West Bengal Panchayat Elections Act, 2003 read with Rules 26 & 27 of the West Bengal Panchayat Elections
Rules, 2006 the West Bengal State Election Commission hereby determines and publishes, after previous publication of
the Draft of this Order, the Final Order for Delimitation of Cooch Behar Zilla Parishad Constituencies and Reservation of
Seats thereto for Panchayat General Elections, 2023 as required under the said Rules. The Block(s) have been specified
in column (1) of the Schedule below (hereinafter referred to as the said Schedule), the number of members to be elected
to the Zilla Parishad has been specified in the corresponding entries in column (2), the area of the Block has been divided
into constituencies as specified in the corresponding entries in column (3), the constituency or constituencies reserved
for the Scheduled Tribes (ST), the Scheduled Castes (SC) or the Backward Classes (BC) have been determined as
specified in the corresponding entries in column (4) and the constituency or constituencies reserved for Women (W)
have been determined as specified in the corresponding entries in column (5) of the said Schedule.
